brief:
Israel's overwhelming military advantage has not translated into achieving its political objectives in Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The force deployed in the territory has inflicted massive casualties but has not secured the strategic outcomes the operation was designed to accomplish.

Military dominance and political success in Gaza remain separate outcomes. Despite the scale of the military campaign, the stated political goals remain unmet.
dek: Israel’s military might has failed to achieve the political goals in Gaza it was supposed to.
title: Israel's military power fails to achieve Gaza political goals
